parameters.query: INSERT INTO cortex_mission_claims (mission_ref, expert_ref, token_hash, statut, created_at, expires_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 'en_attente', NOW(), NOW() + INTERVAL '2 hours') ON CONFLICT (mission_ref) DO UPDATE SET expert_ref = EXCLUDED.expert_ref, token_hash = EXCLUDED.token_hash, statut = 'en_attente', created_at = NOW(), expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at WHERE cortex_mission_claims.statut <> 'accepte' RETURNING mission_ref, expert_ref, statut, expires_at;
